content: Kitakatelik Facl Sac Inmasrlon Sruf Uh

Pa inge inen sruf uh. Masrol layen nu epang, mutawauk ke Meoa Mediterranean fahla nu kutulap ac ut ke siti Hethlon nu ke Innek In Utyak Nu Hamath, ac safla ke siti Hazarenon, apkuran nu ke masrol lun Damascus ac Hamath. Ip se inge ma lun sruf lal Dan.
Sisken acn lal Dan, kutulap lac nu roto, ip se inge ma lun sruf lal Asher.
Sisken acn lal Asher, kutulap lac nu roto, ip se inge ma lun sruf lal Naphtali.
Sisken acn lal Naphtali, kutulap lac nu roto, ip se inge ma lun sruf lal Manasseh.
Sisken acn lal Manasseh, kutulap lac nu roto, ip se inge ma lun sruf lal Ephraim.
Sisken acn lal Ephraim, kutulap lac nu roto, ip se inge ma lun sruf lal Reuben.
Sisken acn lal Reuben, kutulap lac nu roto, ip se inge ma lun sruf lal Judah.
Sie Acn Srisrila Infulwen Facl Sac

Ipin acn se sisken acn lal Judah, kutulap lac nu roto, ac fah sriyukla in orekmakinyuk nu ke sie sripa yohk. Acn se inge fah mael singoul sralap epang lac nu eir, ac lusa uh ac fah oana lusen acn ma itukyang nu sin sruf uh. Tempul ac fah oan in acn se inge.
Ke infulwen acn se inge, oasr ip se mael singoul lusa ac mael oalkosr sralap, su ac fah kisakinyukyang nu sin LEUM GOD.
Ac fah oasr ip se nu sin mwet tol ke ipin acn mutal se inge. Acn selos inge ac fah mael singoul lusa, kutulap nu roto, ac mael akosr epang nu eir. Tempul lun LEUM GOD ac fah oan infulwen acn se inge.

Acn mutal se inge ac fah ma sin mwet tol su ma ke fwilin tulik natul Zadok. Elos tuh pwayena in kulansap lalos nu sik, ac tia wi mwet Israel saya uh in oru ma koluk, oana ke mwet wialos in sruf lal Levi elos oru.
Ke ma inge, ac fah oasr ipin acn se sriyukla nu selos ma ac oanna sisken acn ma itukyang nu sin sruf lal Levi. Acn se lalos inge pa mutal oemeet.
Mwet in sruf Levi ac fah oasr pac ipin acn se sriyukla nu selos ke layen eir in acn lun mwet tol. Acn se inge ac fah oayapa mael singoul lusa kutulap nu roto, ac mael akosr sralap epang lac nu eir.
Acn se ma kisakinyukla nu sin LEUM GOD pa wo oemeet ke acn nukewa, na wangin ip kac ac fah kukakinyukla, ku ayaolla, ku itukyang nu sin kutena mwet. Acn mutal se pa inge, ac ma na lun LEUM GOD.

Ip se ma lula ke acn srisrila se inge, su lupa uh oasr ke mael singoul lusa ac mael luo sralap, tia acn mutal se, na ku in orekmakinyuk sin mwet uh nu ke kutena enenu saya. Elos ku in muta we ac orekmakin acn sacn. Siti se we ac fah oan infulwen acn se inge,
na ac fah maspang — yact luo tausin lumfoko longoul ke kais sie siska.
Rauneak siti sac nufon ac fah oasr acn mwesas se su lupa oasr ke yact siofok angngaul lac nwe lac.

Acn ma ac lula tukun musaiyukla siti sac, sisken na acn mutal sac layen nu eir — su mael akosr lusa ac mael luo sralap layen nu kutulap, ac mael akosr lusa ac mael luo sralap nu roto — acn inge ac fah orekmakinyuk nu ke acn in ima sin mwet ma muta in siti uh.
Kutena mwet ma muta in siti uh ac ku in imai acn se inge, oana sie sin sruf nukewa.
Ouinge, lupan acn ma oan infulwen acn se ma sriyukla inge ac fah orala sie maspang, su lupa uh oasr ke mael singoul ke siska nukewa, na ac fah oaoayang pacna acn se ma siti sac oan we.

Acn ma lula ke layen kutulap, su mael oalkosr kutu lusa, ac ke layen roto mael oalkosr kutu lusa, ac fah ma lun fisrak se su leumi Israel. Acn inge fahla nwe ke sun masrol nu kutulap, ac nu roto nwe ke Meoa Mediterranean. Tempul, ac acn sin mwet tol, ac acn sin mwet Levi, ac siti sac, pa oan in acn mutal se ingan.
Masrol nu epang uh pa ip se ma itukyang nu sin sruf lal Judah, ac masrol nu eir pa ke acn lun sruf lal Benjamin.
Acn Lun Sruf Saya
Pa inge acn ma itukyang nu sin sruf nukewa saya uh. Acn lun sruf lal Benjamin oan ten liki acn lun fisrak uh, kutulap lac nu roto.
Sisken acn lal Benjamin, kutulap lac nu roto, ip se inge ma lun sruf lal Simeon.
Sisken acn lal Simeon, kutulap lac nu roto, ip se inge ma lun sruf lal Issachar.
Sisken acn lal Issachar, kutulap lac nu roto, ip se inge ma lun sruf lal Zebulun.
Sisken acn lal Zebulun, kutulap lac nu roto, ip se inge ma lun sruf lal Gad.
Masrol nu eir ke acn lun Gad, srola liki acn Tamar ut roto eir nu yen oasr kof we in acn Kadesh, na kuhfla nu roto epang sisken masrol nu Egypt fahla nwe ke sun Meoa Mediterranean.
LEUM GOD Fulatlana El fahk, “Ac fah pa ingan luman kiteyen facl Israel tuh in mwe usru nu sin kais sie sruf lun Israel.”
Mutunpot Lun Jerusalem
Pa inge nien illa liki siti Jerusalem. Ke pot se layen nu epang, su lusa uh yact luo tausin lumfoko longoul,
ac fah oasr mutunpot tolu. Kais sie mutunpot ac fah ekin sruf lun Israel. Inen mutunpot tolu inge pa Mutunpot Reuben, Mutunpot Judah, ac Mutunpot Levi.
Ke pot se nu kutulap, su oayapa yact luo tausin lumfoko longoul, ac fah oasr pac mutunpot tolu: Mutunpot Joseph, Mutunpot Benjamin, ac Mutunpot Dan.
Ke pot se nu eir uh, su oayapa yact luo tausin lumfoko longoul lusa, oasr pac mutunpot tolu: Mutunpot Simeon, Mutunpot Issachar ac Mutunpot Zebulun.
Ke pot se nu roto uh, su oayapa yact luo tausin lumfoko longoul lusa, oasr pac mutunpot tolu: Mutunpot Gad, Mutunpot Asher, ac Mutunpot Naphtali.
Lusen pot se inge nufon ma rauneak siti se inge pa yact singoul tausin oalngoul. Ke pacl se ingela, inen siti se inge ac fah pangpang, “LEUM GOD El Oasr Inge!”
